title: View and select a compliance framework
summary: A draft guide for reviewing available frameworks and recording the appropriate selection.

items: Know which regulatory, contractual, or internal requirement your organisation is addressing.
Confirm which person is responsible for choosing the framework.
Have the approved framework list or product guidance available.
Open the part of DRisk where available frameworks are shown.
Review the framework names, descriptions, and applicability information shown in your environment.
Compare the available options with your organisation's confirmed needs.
Select the appropriate framework using the approved product workflow.
Record any decision or follow-up required by your internal process.
